Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
There is [a new volume of Cameos](../books.html#134) just ready to come out, ending at Queen Elizabeth’s death. I suppose it must be called ‘Wars of the Reformation’ I do not like the term Wars of Religion.
I am also finishing off [Stray Pearls](../books.html#170), which will be completed in the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52) in June, in 32 or 33 chapters - so I suppose it may come out about that time.

It is a sort of continuation of [the Chaplet of Pearls](../books.html#69) in the time of the Fronde, when the cavaliers were in exile.

Will you kindly desire a copy of [Magnum Bonum](../books.html#131) and of the [Clever Woman](../books.html#58) to be sent me
Yours very truly

C M Yonge
